diagrams.title: Retrieval Robustness — layers and data flow
diagrams.content:
flowchart LR
  subgraph s_consumer["Consumer"]
    prompt["Agent prompt — ## Communication Board block"]
  end

  subgraph s_assembly["Assembly — retrieve_board_context()"]
    direction TB
    ch_gov["1. Governance — pending decisions + escalations"]
    ch_ref["2. Referenced — context_refs hydrated authoritative text"]
    ch_ctx["3. Context / Auto-derived — semantic, capped 2000 chars"]
    ch_cat["4. Catalog — up to 12 pull-on-demand pointers"]
  end

  subgraph s_search["Search — hybrid retrieval"]
    direction TB
    bm25["BM25 — FTS5 ORDER BY rank (search_by_keyword)"]
    vec["Vector cosine — sqlite-vec over all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (search_by_embedding)"]
    rrf["Reciprocal Rank Fusion — score = 1/(60+bm25_rank) + 1/(60+sem_rank)"]
    gates["Relevance gates — per-tier distance cutoff + CT4 keyword bound"]
  end

  subgraph s_storage["Storage — ~/.pathly/pathly.db"]
    direction TB
    t_msg["comms_messages — context_refs JSON"]
    t_emb["comms_embeddings — vector rows"]
    t_fts["comms_fts — external-content, trigger-synced"]
    t_chunk["comms_chunk_embeddings — subtopic rescue (empty / dormant)"]
  end

  subgraph s_degrade["Degradation and health"]
    direction TB
    latch["_VEC_AVAILABLE / _FTS_AVAILABLE — set-once latch, silent no-op"]
    health["retrieval_status() /health — fts_rows, integrity_ok, degraded"]
  end

  t_msg -->|"plain WHERE SQL, no ranking"| ch_gov
  t_msg -->|"context_refs -> hydrate section"| ch_ref

  t_fts --> bm25
  t_emb --> vec
  t_chunk -.->|"dormant merge"| vec
  bm25 --> rrf
  vec --> rrf
  rrf --> gates
  gates --> ch_ctx
  t_msg -->|"pointers"| ch_cat

  ch_gov --> prompt
  ch_ref --> prompt
  ch_ctx --> prompt
  ch_cat --> prompt

  latch -.->|"gates on/off"| vec
  latch -.->|"gates on/off"| bm25
  vec -.->|"vec down -> recency"| gates
  bm25 -.->|"FTS down -> semantic-only"| gates
  latch --> health
  t_fts -.->|"integrity-check / rebuild"| health
  health -->|"loud RUNNER_WARNING when degraded"| prompt
